title: Matcher Exceptions Unmatched Items
summary:
All users can learn how to navigate the Unmatched items tab on the Exceptions page and perform the following tasks:
- Match items
- Create a reconciliation group memo
- Create new journal entries
- Use the suggested matching feature
- Export items to Excel
- Adjust item grid and save grid view
- Add text to multiple items
- View selected transactions
- Manually register items
- Group and undo grouping of transactions
- Send for investigation
- Send to balancer
